# Nobody answers a sev1 page. Each role has a deadline on its wait: the primary 3 minutes, the secondary 3 and the manager 5, and a minute lasts one second here.
# Every wait times out and the next role is paged. The proposal is a restart, a safe row, so after the last role the desk runs it by policy and pages the commander.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=1
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec beehavereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

# Each role was paged once for the approval. The primary has the heads-up page as well. The commander got one page, after the chain.
grep -count=2 '^incident-2 primary$' pages.log
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 secondary$' pages.log
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 manager$' pages.log
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 commander$' pages.log

# The timeline records each deadline that passed, in order.
grep 'no answer from primary inside 3 minutes' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep 'no answer from secondary inside 3 minutes' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep 'no answer from manager inside 5 minutes' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv

# The safe row ran once, under the policy.
grep -count=1 '^restart incident-2-restart$' writes.log
grep 'approved by policy: no answer after the whole chain, safe row' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep '^incident-2 mitigated$' status.log
! exists restores.log
exists home/.incident/postmortems/incident-2.md
exec beehavereal status
stdout 'item-incident-2-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
